# G10 market notes for flies

Per-market behaviour, drivers and examples. Main text: [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md). Numbers: [published-fly-data](published-fly-data.md).
Conventions (indices, day counts, benchmark tenors): [fi-g10-market-conventions](../../fi-g10-market-conventions/SKILL.md). The sources
are strongest for USD and EUR; other markets rest on screens and a few trades, so treat them as hypotheses to verify with data.

| Market | What matters for flies | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| USD | Standing swap fly monitors (equal-weight and PCA, 5y window, ~30 flies spot and 1y/2y/3y forward); front-end fly-on-belly regressions (Eurodollar then SOFR). Belly cheapens in easing cycles, 5s richen at the ZLB. 10s20s30s is the textbook regression/PCA fly; 20s driven by variable-annuity/insurer hedging and long-end convexity demand; 7y residuals mean-revert on mortgage-servicer hedging. Treasury long-end purchases push term premium into the 10y (reason to pay 5s10s30s). Forward 5s10s30s flies are traded as roll-down / short-vol proxies. | Citi US Rates Weekly 2017-2023, 2 Oct 2026; Tuckman and Serrat 2022; J.P. Morgan 23 Aug 2019; Burton et al. c.2008; Barclays 2 Oct 2026 |
| USD cash | Delivery-basket changes create idiosyncratic CTD-sector flies (2030 sector in 2015; Ultra bond announcement cheapened the bond-curve belly vs the new basket in 2009). Low free float and SOMA holdings hurt liquidity of a cash-fly belly. | Citi, The long end basket case, 4 Feb 2015; Credit Suisse, UST Futures Focus, 28 Sep 2009 |
| EUR | Swap flies on spot and non-overlapping forwards (spot 1y, 1y1y ... 10y2y, 12y3y, 15y5y ... 40y10y); PC1 largest in 1y1y-5y1y (bear-flattening more likely). 5s10s30s co-moves with vol (tightens in rallies, widens in sell-offs) and the 10y cheapens in equity risk-off; 20y ALM receiving is the risk to paid 20y bellies; pay 10/20/30 belly for carry (Nordea). EGB residuals by country (SP/IT/BE/FR/AT/NL/FI/DE at 2/5/10/30y); the Dutch pension reform (FTK II) caused structural 15y5y vs 25y5y residuals. 2s5s10s belly normally has large positive carry but only a few bp in Feb 2020. 2s5s10s was "fairly immune to rate direction" in early 2020; PC1-neutral 2s7s10s has a convex relation to level (inflection near a 0% 7y). Euribor futures are the closest equivalent of non-overlapping 1y forwards (limit to the first ~16 contracts); Sep20-Jun21 Euribor flattener = 6M-FRA 3M/12M flattener. OAT/OLO/DSL and Bund-OLO-OAT bond flies exist but 20y OAT fly was too illiquid to size. | Credit Suisse 2012; BNP 25 May 2021; ING 2020; Nordea 2019-2025; Citi Morning Call 12 Aug 2026; Citi Radar 13 Aug 2026; J.P. Morgan 21-22 Aug 2026; Astor Ridge Trade Radar, Mar 2022 |
| GBP | 10s20s30s shows 20y richening from ALM/pension demand (risk transfer, longevity) and fiscal/inflation premia; SONIA 3s5s7s belly driven by mortgage-hedge paying vs bank structural-hedge receiving; linker (UKTi) barbells weighted cash- and duration-neutral daily, redemptions distort short-dated linkers; sell 10y gilt vs 5/30 wings (Barclays). GBP 2s10s30s and 5s10s30s were top movers in Sep 2026 (5s10s30s +7bp, 4.4 sd over 1m). 30y10y-40y10y residuals vs EUR. | BofA UK Rates Viewpoint 5 Sep 2024; Citi Fixing the plumbing 30 Sep 2019; Credit Suisse 2012; GS Market Movers 30 Sep 2026 |
| JPY | JGB liquidity at times cut "to a trickle" by official buying and no meaningful on-the-run premium: build the analysis on fitted/swap curves. JGB 5s10s30s body-short example; JPY 1y1y/2y1y/3y1y forward fly top-ranked on carry/entry/trend in the GS screen. Vol-surface curvature factor F3 is "the only good RV factor in Japan" (fast mean reversion, low correlation to F1/F2) and needs three instruments; conditional 7s10s20s was the only conditional fly with stable directionality plus pick-up (2012). | J.P. Morgan 21-22 Aug 2026; GS 30 Sep 2026; Huggins and Schaller 2024 |
| CAD | Forward 1y1y/2y1y/3y1y fly had top carry but conflicting entry and trend signals in the screen. | GS 30 Sep 2026 |
| AUD | 1y-forward 2s5s10s receive-belly fly (growth concerns keep the belly in vogue while inflation risk makes cuts hard to price); main risk dovish RBA pricing and long-end demand vs belly. Screen pick AUD 1y 2s5s10s receive. | Citi Radar 13 Aug 2026; GS 30 Sep 2026 |
| NZD | Forward 10y5y/15y5y/20y5y fly appeared in the screen (Carry -0.15, Entry 0.61, Trend -9.97, score 1.89). | GS 30 Sep 2026 |
| CHF | Forward 7y3y/10y2y/12y3y fly in the screen; thin curve and few liquid points, so prefer forward-point flies over spot. | GS 30 Sep 2026 |
| SEK / NOK | Shorter fly universes in the screens (NOK 5y1y/6y2y/8y1y); illiquid, size by the thinnest leg and widen cost assumptions. | GS 30 Sep 2026 |

## Cross-market checklist before porting a threshold
1. Re-estimate weights per market on its own history; do not carry US weights to EUR (EUR PC-neutral 2s5s10s needed -2.41:2:-0.66
   in Mar 2020 vs USD 2s5s10s PCA -0.36:1:-0.72 in 2019).
2. Check the pinned leg: a market where the 2y is anchored by the policy rate turns 2s/x/y flies into x/y curve trades.
3. Identify the structural-flow point (US 20y/7y, EUR 20y, GBP 20y, DE 30y) and whether it is the belly or a wing.
4. Cash flies: benchmark and CTD changes, free float, repo specialness of the belly; swap flies: confirm the same fixing/indices for all legs.
5. Costs: use live bid/offer for the thinnest leg; a 1bp bid-ask erased the profits of a statistically optimal swap fly.
